legal_entity.description: Legal entities of the group (master data, parent of everything).
legal_entity.cardinality: 1:N bank_account; 1:N receivable/payable/cash_flow_forecast; self-reference N:1 parent (optional); N:M forecast_run via forecast_run_entity

fields.name: parent_entity_id
fields.rule: optional; parent id < own id (acyclic); NULL for holding

fields.name: status
fields.rule: current lifecycle state; history in state_event

fields.name: min_liquidity_buffer_usd_minor
fields.rule: >= 0; derived = 2.0 x mean monthly payables (USD-equivalent at opening FX)

bank_account.description: Bank accounts held by legal entities.

fields.name: currency
fields.rule: ISO 4217; every ledger entry on the account must use this currency

fields.name: opening_balance_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: overdraft_limit_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: statement_date
fields.rule: bank statement as-of date = closed_date or data cutoff

fields.name: statement_closing_balance_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)
fields.rule: bank-reported closing balance; must equal opening + sum(ledger) unless labelled BALANCE_MISMATCH

ledger_entry.cardinality: N:1 bank_account; N:1 cash_flow_forecast (optional, 0..N settlements per item)

fields.name: amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: signed_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: balance_after_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: cf_id
fields.rule: set for settlements of scheduled items

fields.name: source_ref_id
fields.rule: RCV-/PAY- id of the settled document (consistent with cf_id)

fields.name: account_id
fields.rule: receiving account; same entity; same currency as invoice

fields.name: counterparty_risk_tier
fields.rule: drives payment delay / partial / write-off behaviour

fields.name: invoice_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: settled_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)
fields.rule: derived = sum of linked ledger credits

fields.name: outstanding_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)
fields.rule: derived = invoice - settled while OPEN/OVERDUE/PARTIALLY_PAID else 0

fields.name: invoice_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: settled_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: outstanding_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

cash_flow_forecast.description: Forecast item: one expected cash flow derived from exactly one receivable or payable.
cash_flow_forecast.cardinality: 1:1 receivable|payable; 1:N ledger_entry (settlements); N:M forecast_run via forecast_run_item

fields.name: scheduled_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: expected_date
fields.rule: original expected cash date (business day); immutable

fields.name: revised_at
fields.rule: >= created_date and < expected_date; date the revision became known

fields.name: created_date
fields.rule: date the item entered the forecast (= invoice_date)

fields.name: confidence_score
fields.rule: 0..1; derived from counterparty tier and revision

fields.name: realized_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)
fields.rule: derived = sum of linked ledger entries

fields.name: realized_date
fields.rule: date of last linked ledger entry

currency_rate.description: Daily FX rates (USD per 1 unit of currency). Missing rows are labelled anomalies.
currency_rate.cardinality: referenced logically by currency+date from ledger/position/forecast conversions

fields.name: rate_id
fields.rule: never renumbered when a row is removed

fields.name: fx_shock_pct
fields.rule: applied to non-USD -> USD plan rate; negative = depreciation

fields.name: overdue_rollover_days
fields.rule: overdue items assumed to clear this many days after run date

scenario_assumption.description: One documented parameter per row; must equal liquidity_scenario columns.

forecast_run.description: A versioned execution of a scenario at a run date.
forecast_run.cardinality: N:1 liquidity_scenario; N:M legal_entity via forecast_run_entity; N:M cash_flow_forecast via forecast_run_item; 1:N forecast_daily_position; 1:N forecast_vs_actual; self-reference supersedes (optional)
forecast_run.lifecycle: CREATED -> CALCULATED -> APPROVED | EXCEPTIONS_FLAGGED -> APPROVED|REJECTED ; REJECTED|APPROVED -> SUPERSEDED

fields.name: run_date
fields.rule: forecast as-of date (first day of horizon)

fields.name: data_cutoff_date
fields.rule: = run_date - 1; no actual after this date may be used

fields.name: opening_position_usd_minor
fields.rule: derived: in-scope balances at cutoff x plan FX

fields.name: closing_position_usd_minor
fields.rule: derived: sum of entity projections at horizon end

fields.name: min_position_usd_minor
fields.rule: derived: min over horizon of group projection

fields.name: entities_breaching_buffer
fields.rule: entities projected below min_liquidity_buffer on any day

fields.name: fx_status
fields.rule: STALE_CARRY if a plan rate was carried forward

fields.name: exception_count
fields.rule: run-level exceptions detected at calculation time

fields.name: review_decision
fields.rule: reviewer decision according to documented rule

forecast_run_entity.description: Bridge: entities in/out of scope per run (N:M).

forecast_run_item.description: Bridge: snapshot of each forecast item as used by a run/scenario (N:M).

fields.name: cf_id
fields.rule: (run_id, cf_id) must be unique (else DOUBLE_COUNT anomaly)

fields.name: base_date
fields.rule: expected date known at cutoff (revised if revised_at <= cutoff)

fields.name: scheduled_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)
fields.rule: remaining amount at cutoff (scheduled - settled by cutoff)

fields.name: adjusted_amount_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: fx_rate_to_usd
fields.rule: plan rate at cutoff x (1+scenario fx shock)

fields.name: amount_basis
fields.rule: ACTUAL is only valid if actual ledger date <= data_cutoff_date

daily_cash_position.description: Derived actual daily cash position per bank account.

fields.name: opening_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: inflow_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: outflow_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: closing_minor
fields.unit: minor units of the row's currency (1/100)

fields.name: fx_rate_date
fields.rule: date of the rate used (carry-forward <= 3 days)

fields.name: closing_usd_minor
fields.rule: round(closing x rate); null when MISSING

forecast_daily_position.description: Projected daily position per run and in-scope entity (USD).

fields.name: projected_closing_usd_minor
fields.rule: sum_ccy plan_rate x (balance at cutoff + cumulative lines + run-rate)

forecast_vs_actual.description: Actual-versus-forecast variance with additive driver decomposition.

fields.name: actual_closing_usd_minor
fields.rule: actual ledger balances x actual FX of the day

fields.name: amount_effect_usd_minor
fields.rule: settled amount differs from scheduled (partial pay, haircut)

fields.name: fx_effect_usd_minor
fields.rule: actual FX vs plan FX on actual balances

fields.name: primary_driver
fields.rule: effect with the largest absolute value

state_event.description: Append-only lifecycle history for all stateful objects (no overwrites).

fields.name: object_id
fields.rule: id of the object in its own table (polymorphic; validated in code)

fields.name: from_state
fields.rule: NULL for creation event; must equal previous to_state
